The '''Ulabos ice bands''' were immense [[Planetary ring/Legends|rings]] of [[Water/Legends|ice]] and rock that surrounded [[Ulabos]],<ref name="CSWE" /> the eleventh [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|Coruscant Prime]].<ref name="CatCW" />
